main_visual_task: A real barista opens the cafe to the sunrise and makes the first coffee of the day - blinds rise, beans pour, the bed blooms - in four motivated internal shots where the person always serves the coffee and never competes with it.

user_script_review.note: 「日出开门」有人版8镜方案获用户批准（飞书），含产品记忆收尾+反动漫三道闸

prompt_bible.subject_lock: one real barista seen from behind or by the hands only in this segment, wearing a charcoal linen apron over a plain white shirt with short dark hair, natural human proportions with five fingers per hand, plus the unlabeled glass pour-over set, wooden bean jar and gooseneck kettle; no branding anywhere
prompt_bible.environment_lock: a small modern city cafe interior before opening, wooden counter, rain-fresh window, soft blue pre-dawn light warming into sunrise, no other people inside or outside
prompt_bible.material_lock: real human skin with visible pores and micro-texture, real linen and cotton fabric weave, real oily beans, fine coffee powder, glass refraction, crema bubbles and rising steam, all physically plausible
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: first hard warm sunrise key from upper left with a fixed cool blue fill from the window
prompt_bible.palette_lock: deep espresso brown, morning gold, cool window blue, charcoal linen gray, cream white
prompt_bible.lens_texture: live-action 35mm commercial cinematography on a real cinema camera, true-to-life photographic rendering, natural skin subsurface scattering, practical light falloff, filmic contrast, shallow macro depth of field
prompt_bible.screen_direction: energy and liquid travel left-to-right across cuts; label areas remain blank
prompt_bible.audio_policy: diegetic rhythm only: blinds rise, beans rattle, water spiral hiss, pour; no voice and no dialogue

internal_shots.visual_state: dim pre-dawn cafe interior, the barista stands at the window with their back to camera raising the blinds
internal_shots.subject_action: the blinds rise and the first sunrise beam lands on the bean jar at the wooden counter
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow push-in from the room toward the lit counter
internal_shots.focus: barista silhouette then the bean jar catching the light
internal_shots.lighting_state: cool blue pre-dawn interior warms where the beam strikes
internal_shots.end_state: the beam fully owns the bean jar and counter as the barista begins to turn

camera_plan.motivation: let the light choose the product before the person is ever seen
camera_plan.start_position: wide interior framing from the door
camera_plan.path: push slowly toward the window counter along the beam axis
camera_plan.speed_curve: slow constant creep with no acceleration
camera_plan.focus_transition: silhouette outline to bean jar highlight
camera_plan.end_position: medium wide on the lit counter
camera_plan.axis_lock: beam travels from upper-left window to counter, camera on that axis
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the beam lands full on the jar

internal_shots.visual_state: the barista's two hands tip roasted beans from a small wooden scoop into the grinder hopper
internal_shots.subject_action: beans tumble and rattle into the hopper with real skin and fabric weave visible
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow push-in toward the falling bean stream
internal_shots.focus: falling beans and the hands' skin texture
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key now steady, raking across knuckles and beans
internal_shots.end_state: the last beans settle as the hand withdraws toward the grinder crank

camera_plan.motivation: the first tactile human contact belongs to the beans
camera_plan.start_position: close-up level with the hopper mouth
camera_plan.path: push slowly toward the hopper opening following the bean stream
camera_plan.speed_curve: slow constant push with gentle ease
camera_plan.focus_transition: falling beans to settling mound to withdrawing hand
camera_plan.axis_lock: beans fall front-to-back while hands stay right-of-center
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the hand leaves the frame edge

internal_shots.visual_state: the coffee bed swells under a thin spiral pour as the bloom crust rises and exhales steam
internal_shots.subject_action: grounds bubble and glisten while crema oils surface
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow short orbit around the blooming bed
internal_shots.focus: spiral water tongue and the swelling crust
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key strobes softly through rising steam
internal_shots.end_state: the crust settles into a dark glossy pool

camera_plan.motivation: the transformation core needs no human interference
camera_plan.start_position: low macro orbit position at crust level
camera_plan.path: orbit a short thirty-degree arc around the crust center
camera_plan.focus_transition: water spiral to crust bubbles to glossy pool
camera_plan.end_position: low macro on the settled dark pool
camera_plan.axis_lock: orbit clockwise only with no vertical drift
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the pool turns mirror-still

internal_shots.visual_state: a hand in a white shirt sleeve holds the gooseneck kettle and pours a steady spiral over the coffee bed
internal_shots.subject_action: the pour spirals evenly while steam ribbons rise past the sleeve
internal_shots.camera_action: one vertical tracking move descending with the pour stream
internal_shots.focus: water stream spiral and the visible sleeve cuff
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key backlights the steam and the falling stream
internal_shots.end_state: the kettle lifts and the bed sits glossy and ready to draw

camera_plan.motivation: the human hand steers but the water is the event
camera_plan.start_position: close-up level with the kettle spout
camera_plan.path: track straight down alongside the pour stream to the bed
camera_plan.speed_curve: match the pour then ease as the kettle lifts
camera_plan.focus_transition: spout stream to bed sheen to lifting kettle
camera_plan.end_position: close-up on the glossy coffee bed
camera_plan.axis_lock: vertical descent only with the pour left-of-center
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the kettle leaves the frame top

first_frame: dim cafe interior at pre-dawn with a barista silhouette at the window and a beam of sunrise light landing on the bean jar
last_frame: close-up of the glossy bloomed coffee bed with steam rising after the kettle lifts
